identity: An Arabic Wikipedia encyclopedia article, تاريخ المنهج العلمي (History of the scientific method), translated from English. Structure: a two-paragraph lead (definition sentence, then a thematic survey of the rationalism / inductivism / hypothetico-deductivism / realism debates), then the bare section heading المنهجية القديمة standing alone as its own one-line paragraph, then four body paragraphs of chronological narrative (Egyptian medical papyri, Babylonian astronomy, the Greeks and the pre-Socratics, Indian schools and Plato/Hellenistic medicine). Register: formal expository MSA, third person, dense with proper names, transliterated foreign names and dates. Syntax is translation-shaped: long و-chained predications, fronted temporal adverbials, and heavy relative clauses.
law: A boundary marks where the source text had sentence-final punctuation, i.e. the end of a complete predication that closes its topic. The natural unit here is LONG, roughly 15 to 55 tokens, because coordination with و and subordination are used INSIDE sentences rather than between them. A new sentence opens when the following token is: (1) an asyndetic new predication whose verb and subject cannot be governed by the previous clause (ظهرت، كان أرسطو، اشتمل، أقصى، بلغ، كان طاليس، كان الإغريق); (2) a FRONTED temporal or locative PP standing before its verb, with or without و (في القرون الماضية، في منتصف القرن الخامس، في محاورة بروتاغوراس، وفي القرنين، ونهاية القرن); (3) additive كما + verb; (4) the أما ... فـ topic-shift frame; (5) an anaphoric summary predication كان ذلك; (6) adversative إلا أن when it is NOT the apodosis of a preceding على الرغم من. A new sentence never opens with a subordinator or relativiser: التي، الذي، حيث، بينما، عندما، إذا، سواء، أن، and clitic فـ are all comma-level cohesion, below period strength. Bare و + finite verb with a continuing topic is intra-sentential coordination, not a break; it breaks only when the clause installs a genuinely new topic or a new named attribution. Forced and inviolable: the token before every <NL> and the final token carry boundaries; no <NL> token itself may carry one; the heading is its own unit.
reasoning: (a) i=31 العلوم before وتجادل الفلاسفة: REJECTED. لم تكن قواعد... / وكان المنهج... / وتجادل الفلاسفة... is a single three-limb و-chain on one topic (the contested status of method); nothing resets subject-side in a way the chain cannot carry, and the next clause وعلى الرغم من الخلافات presupposes the whole chain as already stated. A 30-token lead sentence is well inside this text's scale. (b) i=168 الميلادي versus i=176 الميلاديين: chose 168. Reading the dates as one coordinated time-phrase would make the claim self-contradictory, putting hypothetico-deductivism at the fore in the early 19th AND the late 19th AND the early 20th century at once. The dual الميلاديين agrees only with القرن التاسع عشر وبداية القرن العشرين, so ونهاية القرن... is a fronted adverbial belonging to كان الجدل ... مسيطرا. Marked med only because the fronting drops في. (c) i=196 الإدراك before بينما: REJECTED. بينما is a contrastive subordinator and the two halves it joins (the late-19th realism debate versus the mid-20th denial of universal rules) are exactly the contrast it exists to carry. The break falls instead at 212 الإطلاق, where في القرون الماضية opens asyndetically on a new topic, statistical method. (d) i=228 الخطأ: forced by syntax, not style. كان ذلك توابع لنهج فرانسيس بيكون is juxtaposed with no connector at all and is anaphoric to the entire preceding clause, so only a period can be the joint. (e) i=255 المعتقدات before وظهر أثر ذلك: REJECTED under the و+verb test. ذلك is anaphoric to مراجعة المعتقدات named immediately before it, so the clause completes the same thought (Bayesian inference, then belief revision, then whose trace shows in Ramsey, Keynes and Jevons) instead of opening a new one. (f) i=410 الفلكية before ويزعم المؤرخ: ACCEPTED even though it is also و+verb. This is the licensed exception: the clause switches to a named attribution, Asger Aaboe, governing a very large أن-complement, and refusing the break would yield one 73-token paragraph-sentence, far outside this text's range. This site is what defines the exception rather than contradicting the rule. (g) i=475 كلها before إلا أن البابليين: ACCEPTED, med. Contrast with i=52, where إلا أن is the obligatory apodosis of وعلى الرغم من and therefore cannot be a sentence start. Here no رغم is waiting to be answered, so إلا أن is free-standing adversative however, and the preceding أسس... وكذلك أسسوا... ووضعوا قوائم للأنواع كلها is an already-closed inventory. (h) i=558 طبيعي before وعلى الرغم من أنه: REJECTED. Taken as its own sentence that stretch would be a headless concessive (على الرغم من أنه عرف بقوله ... بل وضحى بثور) with no main clause anywhere after it, since أما ليوكيبوس فقد introduces a different subject. It must therefore lean back on كان طاليس أول من استخدم, and the real break is at 574 نظريته, immediately before أما...فـ. (i) i=629 المعرفة before a SECOND كما (كما تشككت): ACCEPTED, med. Two additive كما heads cannot stack inside one sentence; the first, كما انتهجت at 620, already opens a sentence at the licensed break 619, so the second must open the next one. (j) i=641 الحقيقية and i=660 الحقيقة: both REJECTED. وحذرت is same-subject verb coordination, still مدرسة شارفاكا, and فالحقيقة المستدل عليها is clitic فـ drawing the consequence of the conditional immediately before it, which is comma-level cohesion. (k) i=337 المرض and i=762 الطبية: both REJECTED because the next token is التي and حيث respectively, and neither can head a sentence. That is why the Edwin Smith clause runs unbroken from 308 to 363 and the Erasistratus bird-weighing clause hangs off حيث inside the sentence that starts at 748. (l) Heading: tokens 270-271 المنهجية القديمة sit between the <NL> at 269 and the <NL> at 272 and form one unit ending at 271; 268 and 271 are both forced, and neither <NL> is marked.
